## Bag Lookout 1.0

First release.

- A small counter shows your free and total bag slots, for example "Bags 12/98". It turns yellow at or below your warning threshold and red when no slot is left.
- One warning in the middle of the screen with a sound when your free slots drop to the threshold (5 by default), and one more when the bags are full. No repeats while you keep looting; it warns again only after you made room above the threshold.
- The reagent bag is counted on its own: click the counter to show or hide it.
- Drag the counter where you like it. `/bl lock` locks it in place, `/bl hide` and `/bl show` hide and show it.
- `/bl` or `/baglookout` shows the state and the commands. `/bl threshold <0-50>` sets the warning point, `/bl sound on` or `off` switches the sound.

## Bag Lookout 1.1

- New **split view by bag type**: under the counter, one line for the reagent bag and one line for each kind of profession bag, for example "Herbs 12/36" or "Mining 0/24". Several bags of the same kind are added up.
- Profession bags are named for herbs, mining, enchanting, engineering, gems, inscription, leather, fishing and cooking; any other kind is shown as "Profession".
- Each line turns yellow at your warning threshold and red when that bag type is full.
- Click the counter or type `/bl view split` and `/bl view total` to switch. The total view shows your normal bags, as in 1.0.
- Warnings work as before and only follow your normal bags.
- If you had the reagent bag shown in 1.0, you start in the split view. All other settings are kept.

## Bag Lookout 1.2

- New **choice of warning sound**: `/bl sound bell`, `chime`, `horn`, `warning` or `whisper` picks the sound and plays it once. `warning` is the sound of 1.0 and 1.1 and stays the default.
- `/bl sound none` or `/bl sound off` keeps the warnings silent, `/bl sound on` brings your chosen sound back. `/bl sound` lists the choices.
- New **warn once per session**: with `/bl warn once`, "almost full" and "full" each come only once until you log in again. `/bl warn always` warns every time the bags fill up again, as before.
- `/bl` now shows the chosen sound and how often you are warned.
- The warning threshold works as before: `/bl threshold <0-50>`.
- All settings from 1.1 are kept.

## Bag Lookout 1.3

- New **cheapest items list**: `/bl cheap` shows the 5 items in your normal bags that are worth the least at a vendor, counting the whole stack in the slot. It tells you what to throw out or sell first when space runs short.
- Only grey, white and green items are listed. Quest items, items without a vendor price and anything blue or better are left out.
- Items in the reagent bag and in profession bags are not listed, because the warnings follow your normal bags.
- The "bags full" warning now has a second line with the cheapest item, for example "Cheapest: [Linen Cloth] (12c)".
- Items the game has not loaded yet are skipped, and `/bl cheap` says so. Try again a moment later.
- All settings from 1.2 are kept.

## Bag Lookout 1.4

- Bag Lookout now speaks **German**: the counter, the warnings, the tooltip and every chat line. On clients in other languages it stays in English.
- The split view names each kind of bag exactly as the game does, in your client's language, for example "Herb Bag 12/36" or "Reagent Bag 30/36". A kind the game has no name for still shows as "Profession Bag".
- Amounts in `/bl cheap` and under the "bags full" warning now use the game's own coin display.
- The commands stay the same in every language, for example `/bl view split` or `/bl warn once`. The sound names `warning`, `bell`, `chime`, `horn` and `whisper` stay as they are, too.
- All settings from 1.3 are kept.
